windows_updates.title: Trusted Windows update channel
windows_updates.description: ADMIN ONLY. A fixed HTTPS catalog provides the approved version; a separate fixed HTTPS release directory provides signed Windows archives. Pin the Ed25519 PUBLIC key directly from your supervised local provisioning (never from MQTT). MQTT Install remains disabled until explicitly enabled AND the Windows PC advertises signed v2 capability. The Windows updater must also have a trusted Authenticode signer, protected task and rollback. Never paste private signing keys, passwords or child details here. Updating this form does not deploy, install or activate any Windows agent.

data.ota_install_enabled: Enable signed MQTT Install (after trusted PC bootstrap)

screen_idle.title: Screen idle bonus (experimental)
screen_idle.description: **Preview — not hardware validated.** When enabled, live, verified Windows console OFF observations stop charging new tracked-game intervals until a fresh ON return. A separate daily bonus is possible ONLY for continuously measured foreground time before a real display-off event and only when matching the configured Windows power timeout. Console OFF may NOT mean every physical monitor is dark. Game controllers, manual monitor-off, disconnects and multi-monitor configurations require real-PC validation. No gaming processes are stopped, no Windows settings change, and the feature is OFF by default. Test on a disposable PC before enabling for children.

data.screen_idle_enabled: Enable Screen idle preview for this PC
data.screen_idle_acknowledged: I understand this is an experimental feature and requires real-PC validation

unified_telemetry.title: Unified MQTT telemetry v3 — experimental
unified_telemetry.description: Per-PC HA source cutover, OFF by default. Windows 0.3.0 is a BREAKING CLEAN CUT: its monitoring uses ONLY strict, non-retained Unified telemetry v3 and it does NOT publish legacy v2 foreground/display/scalar states. During an approved joint HA+Windows maintenance window, enable this option for the exact PC as part of the coordinated upgrade. Before the v3 publisher is online, HA intentionally shows UNKNOWN and does not fall back, charge unseen gaming minutes, or grant Screen Idle bonuses. To roll back you must restore the compatible previous Windows agent AND this HA selection together. Existing app settings, unique IDs and Recorder history are preserved. This form does NOT deploy or update Windows.

data.unified_telemetry_enabled: Use Unified MQTT telemetry v3 for this PC
data.unified_telemetry_acknowledged: I understand Windows 0.3.0 has NO v2 fallback; switching telemetry formats requires a coordinated PC + HA upgrade or rollback
